Rohit V: Quick sync: console wants an atomic apply flow so UI can Preview -> Stage -> Commit flags without partial activation across routes. Can we design a simple server-side primitive?
Mei L: Sounds good. Failure modes: partial apply across clusters, quota oversubscription when shifting weights, and concurrent edits.
Owen C: Proposal: three-step API: POST /config/apply-intent -> returns apply_id + preview; POST /config/apply-stage -> accepts weight_map and writes STAGED; POST /config/apply-commit -> transitions to COMMITTING and coordinates workers. Use Idempotency-Key and If-Match ETag for safety.
Rohit V: How do we avoid long locks during COMMITTING? We should make COMMITTING short: workers pull staged changes and apply locally; commit waits for cluster acks with a timeout, then either mark ACTIVE or rollback to STAGED. No global lock.
Mei L: OK. For quotas, add safety_headroom_pct in intent (default 20%). Before staging, run a simulate job against recent 1h usage. If projected consumption > quota - headroom, reject intent.
Owen C: Simulate should be async and return job_id. Console can subscribe to kafka topic config.simulate.<job_id> for progress. Keep simulation deterministic via tenant-hash sampling_seed.
Rohit V: Telemetry: emit config.apply.events with apply_id, state transitions, sim_job_id, and flag keys. Also tag pre/post aggregates so alerting can link by apply_id.
Mei L: Alert rules: auto-rollback if error_rate delta > 1.5pp across >10% tenants OR p50 latency increases by >200ms sustained 5m. Use tenant-bucketed histograms to avoid single-tenant noise.
ops-bot: Note: canary deploy scheduled for config-service v3 at 2026-03-25T06:00:00Z.
Owen C: Migration: adapter will translate current /flags/update into apply-intent + commit for simple toggles for 7 days. Need audit trail and runbook creation option notify_ops=true.
Rohit V: Action items: Owen RFC + sample payloads; Mei simulate async job + alerting hooks; I'll work with console on staged UI + confirmation modal.
Mei L: Thanks — I'll add MFA gating for applies >25% traffic and draft help text explaining safety_headroom.
